claims.statement: Every frontend feature or fix must cover desktop and mobile for both Admin and Partner in the same task; the route may use shared responsive markup or swap to dedicated desktop/mobile pages, and any active render path must be updated and verified.
All user-facing text is Vietnamese inlined at the call site; there is no i18n layer and no translation pipeline, so the same word must be used consistently across pages.

The route table branches by role with separate page directories for admin, partner, adv-partner, accountant, employee, and mobile variants; protected routes use a ProtectedRoute guard plus a ResponsivePage switch that renders the desktop or mobile variant based on viewport.

The frontend separates file responsibility strictly: .tsx files render UI only, while .ts files hold business logic, API calls, and type definitions, keeping the hooks/services layer reusable across desktop and mobile variants.
